description: This Java class defines response position mappings for a card-present authorization process within the Authorize.Net integration of the OFBiz accounting application. It extends a base response positions class to specify specific indices for various response fields and provides methods to retrieve position indices and an approval string.

classes.name: CPRespPositions
classes.description: Defines the response field positions for card-present transactions in the Authorize.Net module.

methods.name: getPosition
methods.description: Returns the index position of a given response parameter name, defaulting to -1 if not found.

methods.name: getApprovalString
methods.description: Returns a fixed string "1", likely indicating approval status.
